title: Cytotoxic constituents of Glycosmis ovoidea collected in Vietnam.
authors: Blanco Carcache, Peter J; Anaya Eugenio, Gerardo D; Ninh, Tran Ngoc; Moore, Curtis E; Rivera-Chavez, Jose; Ren, Yulin; Soejarto, Djaja D; Kinghorn, A Douglas
one_liner_zh: 该文研究越南植物Glycosmis ovoidea中香豆素类化合物的细胞毒活性及NF-kappaB抑制机制，属天然产物药理学研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Compounds derived from natural sources have been major contributors to the area of cancer chemotherapy for decades. As part of an ongoing effort to discover anticancer drug leads from tropical plants, a large-scale collection of Glycosmis ovoidea Pierre (Rutaceae), was made at Nui Chua National Park, Vietnam. Activity-guided fractionation of the chloroform-soluble fractions led to the isolation of nine coumarins, including the new compound, 1-(7-methoxy-2-oxo-2H-chromen-8-yl)-3-methyl-1-oxobut-2-en-2-yl (S)-2-methylbutanoate (1). An close analogue of 1, namely, kincuongin (2), was deemed as non-cytotoxic (IC(50) > 10 muM) against five different cancer cell lines. However, co-administration of kimcuongin (2) showed an approximately 100 times potentiation of the MCF-7 breast cancer cell cytotoxicity of the previously reported flavonoid, 5,3'-dihydroxy-3,6,7,8,4'-pentamethoxyflavone (10). To provide a mechanistic basis for the cancer cell line inhibition enhancement observed, an initial in silico study on compound 10 indicated that it interacts with isoforms of the NF-kappaB complex. In a confirmatory western blot experiment conducted, kimcuongin (2) was found to potentiate the effects of flavone 10 in inhibiting both NF-kappaB and PARP-1. In vivo investigations using a zebrafish (Danio rerio) model showed that compounds 2, 3, 5, and 6 did not exhibit any discernible toxicity at concentrations up to 50 muM.
abstract_zh: 数十年来，源自天然来源的化合物一直是癌症化疗领域的重要贡献者。作为从热带植物中发现抗癌药物先导物的持续努力的一部分，我们在越南主山国家公园大规模采集了山小橘属植物Glycosmis ovoidea Pierre（芸香科）。通过活性引导分级分离氯仿可溶部分，分离出九种香豆素，包括新化合物1-(7-甲氧基-2-氧代-2H-色烯-8-基)-3-甲基-1-氧代丁-2-烯-2-基 (S)-2-甲基丁酸酯（1）。化合物1的类似物，即金康素（2），被评估为对五种不同癌细胞系无细胞毒性（IC(50) > 10 μM）。然而，金康素（2）的联合给药显示出对先前报道的黄酮类化合物5,3'-二羟基-3,6,7,8,4'-五甲氧基黄酮（10）在MCF-7乳腺癌细胞中的细胞毒性有约100倍的增强作用。为提供观察到的癌细胞系抑制增强的机制基础，对化合物10进行的初步计算机模拟研究表明，它与NF-κB复合物的亚型相互作用。在进行的验证性蛋白质印迹实验中，发现金康素（2）能增强黄酮10抑制NF-κB和PARP-1的作用。使用斑马鱼（Danio rerio）模型的体内研究表明，化合物2、3、5和6在浓度高达50 μM时未表现出任何明显毒性。
